name: Amazon S3
subtitle: Object storage
creator: Amazon Web Services
description: The original cloud storage for files of any size: images, videos, backups, uploads. Files live in buckets and are reached by URL. Its API became the industry standard that many other providers copy.

concepts.explanation: Cheaper tiers for rarely used files.

codeSamples.label: TypeScript · presigned upload URL

pricing.summary: Pay per GB stored, per request and per GB transferred out. New AWS accounts start with free credits.
